name_origin: Named in honor of an earlier AI project associated with the phrases 'on the river' and 'duke'.

model_identity.release_alias_policy: Create dukeotr only after a compatible export, held-out evaluation, and human release approval; use dukeotr-v1 for the first measured candidate.

dataset_identity.quality_rule: Only quality-gated, deduplicated, evaluation-isolated records count toward a dataset version.

training_factory.policy: Failure records, lineage ledgers, targeted drafts, verified knowledge, Code Book material, development data, and held-out evaluation remain separate with no automatic promotion.

invariants: DukeOTR is the user-facing identity of the finished specialization; Qwen3-4B remains required technical provenance.
DukeOTR is a specialization of the existing pretrained Qwen3-4B base, not a model trained from scratch.
Natural, grammatically correct, varied English is required in curated examples; basic-English filler is not a training priority.
Evaluation prompts, rubrics, baseline answers, and score records never become training input.
Training Factory statistics and targeted briefs may derive only from stored failure evidence, require human review, and never self-promote to source candidates or final training data.
A RemoteEvent is not secure by itself; LocalScripts can call FireServer and the server validates all client-controlled input.
No DukeOTR training, adapter, Ollama import, release alias, or improvement is claimed until its artifact and evaluation evidence exist.
